name: Regional LoRA by masked activation (Nougan)
plain: Gives two characters separate LoRAs on one model, by adding each LoRA's output delta only on the tokens inside its soft rectangle. The rectangle is built on the token grid with sigmoid edges and text tokens get zero. Prompts are separately attached with ordinary conditioning masks.
math:
delta_c = (x·Dᵀ)·Uᵀ·scale (linear layer inputs).
out ← out + Σ_c delta_c·m_c(token), m_c = sigmoid((col−c0)/f)·sigmoid((c1−col)/f)·same for rows, max over the character's rectangles.
If sequence > grid, the first (seq − grid) tokens get 0 (assumed text).

props.hook: PyTorch forward hooks on linears, added with wrappers add_wrapper_with_key and add_wrapper
props.architectures: Layers matched by normalised name; assumes [text, image] token order and a single 2D grid
